rule: Only the #922 interaction coordinator may issue human-facing instructions that mutate or supply task-specific input to the current iPhone StegOS page. All other sessions must remain machine-only/read-only and register desired device interactions as queue candidates rather than asking the user to perform them.
other_sessions_may: perform repository/source work within their own claims
register a requested device interaction candidate
report blockers to the interaction coordinator
other_sessions_must_not: ask the user to tap any StegOS mutation control
ask the user to paste task-specific JSON into StegOS
ask the user to rerun a terminal task
treat stale chat instructions as current admission
resume_condition: Site exposes a single shared interaction state and at most one mutation control; coordinator reconciles current journal after the visible parse failure before admitting a new action.
